terms.definition: The energy transferred from electrical energy to other forms per unit charge, V = W/Q.
terms.examiner: The volt is one joule per coulomb.

terms.definition: The energy transferred from other forms to electrical energy per unit charge, ℰ = W/Q.
terms.examiner: The distinction from p.d. is the direction of the energy transfer.

terms.definition: Potential difference divided by current, R = V/I.
terms.examiner: The ohm is one volt per ampere.

terms.definition: For a metallic conductor at constant temperature, the current is directly proportional to the potential difference across it.
ρ = RA/L: a property of the material, equal to the resistance of a 1 m length with a 1 m² cross-sectional area.
terms.examiner: Unit Ω m. It depends on the material and temperature, not the dimensions.
